name: Testcontainers Open Source (Local)
free_limit: MIT-licensed Testcontainers libraries provide reusable, disposable Docker containers for integration tests without a software usage quota or expiration; local Docker runtime and compute are supplied by the user.
watch_out: This entry covers open-source local Testcontainers libraries, not Testcontainers Cloud or paid hosted resources. Requires a compatible container runtime; CI infrastructure, images, network traffic and hosted compute may incur charges.
